children: Romania's consolidated budget posted a deficit of 2.34% of economic output at end-July, the Finance Ministry said on Monday, compared with a shortfall of 3.99% in the same period of 2025.
In nominal terms, the deficit stood at 48.08 billion lei  ($10.60 billion). Romania targets a deficit of 6.2% of output this year.
